card.title: Outside the Scope
card.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whether I broke the window is outside this repair meeting's scope.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let's hold a responsibility meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the repairs. We need a safe venue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Location changes require a separate planning discussion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whether I broke the window is outside this repair meeting's scope.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let's hold a responsibility meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the repairs. We need a safe venue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Location changes require a separate planning discussion.

mechanism: A keeps moving a responsibility question into another meeting or prerequisite so it never belongs to the current discussion.
confusable: Unlike denying the accusation, A uses jurisdiction and sequence to avoid answering it.
comparison: A proposed outside venue becomes a planning prerequisite; an anniversary dinner cancellation becomes a competing complaint.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
